question: Does the universal P0599 potential-shape amplitude law, frozen on SPARC and 20 CLASH radial profiles, predict held-out raw RX J2129 multiple-image positions?
claim_limits: RX J2129 is one spent cluster pilot, not an independent population validation.
The image positions are raw observables but the baryonic radial profile is a literature reconstruction with a spherical tail closure.
The pseudo-elliptical potential and external shear are fitted structural approximations, not predictions of the scalar field law.
The P0599 amplitude was selected using NFW-deprojected CLASH acceleration profiles, although it was frozen before this raw replay.
Passing a compact one-halo comparator is not equivalent to beating a publication-grade multi-halo dark-matter reconstruction.
